name: Add five predeclared traditional factors to unified5-day and multi-horizon fixed15 accounts
candidate_horizon_reason: Dividend, annual accounting quality/capital expansion/profitability and12-minus1-month momentum are medium-to-long signals; predeclare20-session evaluation for all five rather than optimize separately.

arms.ALL18_5D: add all five candidates, all18 factors use unified5-session RankIC
arms.ALL18_MULTI: original13 mapping plus all five candidates evaluated on20 sessions

unchanged: same broad PIT universe, weekly fixed15 full selection rules, held-top30 buffer, industry/theme/correlation caps, daily target-vol budget, repaired corporate-action/delisting ledger, next-session-close fractional execution
decision: Research candidate only. Compare before/after at both horizon rules, costs, periods and holdings. No automatic adoption and no modification of paper accounts.
limitations: Retrospective observed sample; not untouched holdout.
Adding factors changes both information and allocation of old factors; total return difference is not pure causal alpha of one candidate.
Dividend missingness is neutral after standardization in primary scoring, not asserted zero cash distribution.
Annual financial inputs inherit vendor revisions and are not immutable statement vintages.
Twenty-session labels overlap; only one predeclared candidate horizon is tested.
Fractional shares, simplified fees and research close execution remain.
